release: finish macOS Python runtime packaging

Homebrew-linked inputs must be bundled before the strict shipping checks.
Run those unchanged checks on the final real daemon, CLI, utility and
helper images before producing an archive. Preserve the existing Qt gate
and Linux/Windows input-admission order.

Record the exact source of copied standalone native Python modules outside
the framework so dependency rewriting and signing include _cffi_backend.

Maintained regressions cover both failures and invalid final images.
Follow-up to #705, reusing Jpp-matata's Python inventory from #678.

release: bundle Windows Python and OpenMP

Windows command-line archives omit the Python DLL linked by SwapNet and
the matching standard library and cryptography runtime. The saved native
build also imports an OpenMP DLL that cannot be taken from Visual Studio's
debug_nonredist directory for distribution.

Accept explicit prepared x64 runtimes, retain isolated Python module paths,
resolve native extension dependencies from those inputs and refuse unknown
or conflicting libraries. Stage official LLVM OpenMP under its linked MSVC
compatibility filename with the complete license. Keep dependency checks;
classify four Windows OS DLLs used by the official Python runtime.

Freeze the tested producer inputs and add packaging regression tests.
Native archive evidence reuses Jpp-matata's saved clang-cl build from
64889922; node source and executable bytes are unchanged. Preserve the
existing release packager and runtime work by repch1c, Jpp-matata and numair.
Refs #630.

modelnet: stage snapshot imports before installing state

A late snapshot validation failure returns without reverting changes made
by Apply. A subsequent successful write can persist the rejected repository
and model state. Validate against isolated import state, then publish only
the accepted fields. Preserve existing merge/replay inputs and leave live
runtime restrictions and permits untouched.

Add a lifecycle regression for malformed pieces and mismatched model bytes,
including unrelated save/reload and retained valid model export controls.

release: keep the CPython termios extension out of the Linux archive

CPython 3.14's termios module needs GLIBC_2.42, above the archive ceiling, and SwapNet does not import it.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

release: keep a live SwapNet route and a paused lab plan

A replay from another peer no longer replaces a live next hop, and wallet info is owner scope. An observation no longer clears a paused rollout, and a snapshot piece is checked against the model it names.

test: guard the Unix RPC bridge fixture on Windows

Keep the POSIX header and Unix-socket feed integration case on supported
platforms. All portable bridge cases remain built on Windows; CallUnixRpc
explicitly does not support that platform.

The same generated clang-cl command fails before and compiles after;
20 portable test-case symbols remain in the resulting object.
Refs #356.

doc: explain retained model export recovery

Refs btxchain/btx#613. Preserve the existing recovery walkthrough.
Credit to Numair for the retained-export contract and repch1c for the original recovery fixture work.

doc: say what this build returns for model, bounty, and external sign

The pages that described dial-back, iterative routing, a stored challenge resolution, and a package shape the encoder does not emit now match the helpers and RPCs that are already in the tree.

doc: publish the open SwapNetHTLC code hash and CREATE2 address

The runtime keccak identifies the artifact. The address is the CREATE2 result through the permissionless proxy, so either side can deploy it and neither has to trust a deployer. The node still pins both.

wallet: refuse sendall amounts whose sum does not fit in CAmount

sendall checks each specified amount, then adds them up without an
overflow check. Enough amounts that are each in range wrap the sum, the
check against the inputs passes, and the remainder for the recipients
without an amount is far above MAX_MONEY. The wallet then signed and
stored that transaction, and its balance calls failed until
removeprunedfunds.

Add the amounts with CheckedAdd and refuse a sum that does not fit with
the error sendall already gives when the sum is above the inputs.

modelnet: leave local funding outpoints out of peer and restricted views

preparemodelfunding and submitmodelfunding record the HTLC output script
and the funding outpoint of a local wallet in the release campaign
(setreleaseoutputscript, recordmodelfundingoutpoint). The release cards
show both. The funding transaction is on the chain, but these fields tie
it to a wallet of this node.

The peer route ext/feed served them to any peer, and getrestrictedmodelview,
which btxd uses for a wallet-restricted RPC user, showed them to users
restricted to another wallet or to none. Remove output_script and
funding_outpoints from both, as 5d21f4d2 does for the funding events.
The owner views keep them, and the wallet join in btxd still finds a
wallet's own funding by its model_key_hash.

modelnet: keep ensure files out of directories other users control

ensurebtxcapability wrote below two fixed names in the temp directory:
the checkout of a catalog model in btx-ensure-<artifact id> and the staged
fixture in btx-capability-ensure. Under a temp directory that several
local accounts share, another account can create such a directory first,
with a symlink inside. MaterializeCheckout used an existing directory as
it was and followed a symlink in a subdirectory, so the files of the
operator went, and replaced files, where that account chose.

Check the catalog model out below the helper's own directory. Create the
staging directory with mode 0700, and refuse it when it is a symlink or
belongs to another user (an own directory with a wider mode is made
private). MaterializeCheckout refuses a checkout directory that is a
symlink.

test: run the 190376 signer-progress checks against a header-only tower

chainstate_signer_progress_child_when_best_header_is_competing_fork has
failed at its rollback REQUIRE (:3560) since 28fefe91, and since
2ac77d56 a consensus signer is not meant to roll back to a lower-work
attested sibling at all. The REQUIRE aborted the case, so its three
checks for the 190376 fix had not run since 29 Aug.

Rebuild the setup to match the live stall instead: block A stays the
connected tip and is signed while it is the tip, and the competing fork
is a heavier tower of headers that branches below A and never gets
bodies. The FindMostWorkChain check narrows to A because the tower has
no data, and the HeightOccupied check signs the tower block at A's
height. The 190376 checks themselves are unchanged.

wallet: survive a shorter active chain in shielded block lookups

The shielded wallet reads the tip height and then calls getBlockHash() for
that height: once, for the birth time of a new address
(SeedBirthTimeFromChainTip) and for a transaction view, or for each height
up to it in the rebuild and catch-up loops. getBlockHash() asserts that the
height is on the active chain. If blocks are disconnected in between (a
reorg, invalidateblock), the chain no longer reaches that height, and btxd
stops on that assertion.

Look up the block with findFirstBlockWithTimeAndHeight(), which returns
false instead. The birth time and the transaction view take their existing
path for a missing block. A full rebuild starts again on the shorter chain;
the catch-up, the commitment index rebuild and the SMILE index rebuild take
the path they already take for a missing block. The check of the scan
cursor in the catch-up treats a height that is gone as a mismatch.

wallet: keep searching shielded keys while notes turn up after a restore

After a restore, the first unlock derives the shielded keys for index
0 to 19 and scans the chain once. A note on a later index is not found,
also not after rescanblockchain or a restart. Every shielded send puts its
change on a new index, so after about 20 sends the whole shielded balance
of a wallet is past that window, and the restored wallet shows 0.

Search like a gap limit: while a note turns up within GAP_LIMIT indices of
the end of the searched range, derive the keys up to GAP_LIMIT indices past
that note and scan again. Which keys are kept afterwards is unchanged.

+## 7. Retain a complete model copy for catalog recovery
+
+Cloud payload objects alone are not a catalog backup. If local catalog metadata
+is lost, retain a complete original model directory or independent export to
+re-import. A share URI or `.btx` card alone is not a complete model copy.
+
+### Before local state is lost
+
+Using the usual operator RPC connection, materialize a complete model:
+
+```sh
+btx-cli exportmodelpath '<model URI or model_id>'
+```
+
+The response includes `path`, `model_id`, `artifact_id`, and a `files` list with
+relative paths, sizes and SHA-384 hashes. These paths belong to the helper's
+machine, which may differ from the machine running `btx-cli`.
+
+The returned path is a managed runtime checkout, not an independent backup.
+It may hardlink files from the original input, and `removemodel` deletes the
+checkout. Keep a separate copy:
+
+1. Choose a backup directory outside the helper's modeldir, checkout and original
+   input tree. Keep the source files stable while copying and verifying them.
+2. Copy every listed file into `BACKUP/payload/`, preserving relative paths and
+   bytes. Use independent file copies, not symlinks or hardlink-based copies.
+   Check that the destination files do not share device/inode identities with
+   the source or checkout files on filesystems that expose those identities.
+3. Save the export response as `BACKUP/export-manifest.json`, **outside**
+   `payload/`. Adding recognized sidecar files inside the model directory can
+   change the content IDs when it is imported.
+4. Verify the copied file set, sizes and SHA-384 hashes against the saved response.
+   Keep originals and any previous backup until the new copy is verified.
+
+A separate copy on the same device protects against removal of the managed
+paths; it does not protect against loss of that device. Keep a verified copy
+on separate storage when device-loss recovery is required.
+
+### Restore through normal import
+
+Make the complete copy accessible to the intended helper. With sufficient
+storage quota and the usual operator permissions, import the payload directory:
+
+```sh
+btx-cli importmodel '/absolute/path/to/BACKUP/payload' '{"publish":false,"pin":true}'
+```
+
+Import `payload/`, not the enclosing directory containing the saved response.
+Import recomputes the model and artifact identities and applies the existing
+file-format, integrity and quota checks. `publish:false` suppresses search-card
+publication for this import; it does not disable other configured helper
+activity. The normal import may demand-seed the model.
+
+Compare the returned `model_id` and `artifact_id` with the saved response.
+Export again and compare its complete file set, sizes and hashes. After a normal
+helper restart, repeat that export verification without importing again. Keep
+the independent backup unchanged. The directory name may change the display
+label even when the content IDs match.
+
+This restores model content, not the entire helper state. It does not promise
+restoration of aliases, publisher keys, trust, cloud credentials, jobs, history
+or previous pin/seed settings, and is not a wallet backup. Do not edit catalog
+flags or bypass admission checks to make a partial copy appear complete.

+with a tiny two-file fixture. Earlier Linux recovery evidence covers re-import
+from a surviving complete checkout. Neither qualifies large-model recovery,
+other platforms, power-loss durability, inference or a release. With local
+metadata and all complete copies gone, this candidate does not promise catalog
+reconstruction from cloud objects alone.

+"""Stage an explicit application-local CPython distribution; never download it."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import importlib.util
+import re
+import shutil
+import struct
+import zipfile
+
+
+def verifier():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('windows_bundle_verify', Path(__file__).with_name('verify_release_btxd.py'))
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def require_x64(path):
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    if len(data) < 64 or data[:2] != b'MZ':
+        raise RuntimeError(f'Not a PE runtime image: {path.name}')
+    offset = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 60)[0]
+    if offset + 6 > len(data) or data[offset:offset+4] != b'PE\0\0' or struct.unpack_from('<H', data, offset+4)[0] != 0x8664:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'Runtime image must be x64: {path.name}')
+
+
+def bundle_windows_python(release_root, runtime):
+    """runtime is a prepared official embeddable distribution plus pinned wheels.
+
+    The producer verifies its source hashes. No host installation, registry or
+    user-site paths are copied or added to the isolated module search path.
+    """
+    root = Path(release_root)
+    binary = root / 'bin/btxd.exe'
+    verify = verifier()
+    if verify.classify(binary) != "pe":
+        return []  # The caller's unchanged shipping gate rejects untyped inputs.
+    imports = verify.pe_imports(binary)
+    names = [name for name in imports if re.fullmatch(r'python3\d+\.dll', name, re.I)]
+    if not names:
+        if any(name.lower().startswith('python') for name in imports):
+            raise RuntimeError('Unsupported Python runtime ABI')
+        if b'SwapNet Python initialization failed' in binary.read_bytes():
+            raise RuntimeError('SwapNet has no supported shared Python DLL import')
+        return []
+    if len(names) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError('Ambiguous Python runtime ABI')
+    if runtime is None:
+        raise RuntimeError('Windows SwapNet requires --windows-python-runtime with matching embeddable Python and pinned dependencies')
+    source = Path(runtime)
+    dll = names[0].lower()
+    stem = dll[:-4]
+    if not (source / dll).is_file() or not (source / (stem + '.zip')).is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError('Embeddable runtime does not match the linked Python ABI')
+    if not (source / 'LICENSE.txt').is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError('Python runtime licence is missing')
+    site = source / 'Lib/site-packages'
+    if not (site / 'cryptography/__init__.py').is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError('Pinned cryptography package is missing')
+    native_crypto = list((site / 'cryptography/hazmat/bindings').glob('_rust*.pyd'))
+    if len(native_crypto) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError('Native cryptography package is missing or ambiguous')
+    native_cffi = list(site.glob('_cffi_backend*.pyd'))
+    if len(native_cffi) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError('Native CFFI package is missing or ambiguous')
+    metadata = list(site.glob('cryptography-*.dist-info/METADATA'))
+    if len(metadata) != 1 or '\nVersion: 46.0.4\n' not in ('\n' + metadata[0].read_text()):
+        raise RuntimeError('cryptography must match the tested runtime pin 46.0.4')
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(source / (stem + '.zip')) as stdlib:
+        if 'encodings/__init__.pyc' not in stdlib.namelist() or 'os.pyc' not in stdlib.namelist():
+            raise RuntimeError('Embeddable standard library is incomplete')
+    files = []
+    for path in source.rglob('*'):
+        if path.is_symlink():
+            raise RuntimeError('Runtime symlinks are unsupported')
+        if not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        rel = path.relative_to(source)
+        if len(rel.parts) == 1:
+            if path.suffix.lower() not in {'.dll', '.pyd'} and path.name not in {'LICENSE.txt', 'python.exe', stem + '.zip'}:
+                continue
+        elif rel.parts[:2] != ('Lib', 'site-packages'):
+            continue
+        if '__pycache__' not in rel.parts:
+            files.append((path, rel))
+    if len(files) > 5000 or sum(p.stat().st_size for p, _ in files) > 150 * 1024**2:
+        raise RuntimeError('Runtime input exceeds the supported package bound')
+    out = root / 'bin'
+    included = []
+    def put(src, dst):
+        if dst.exists() and dst.read_bytes() != src.read_bytes():
+            raise RuntimeError(f'Conflicting runtime destination: {dst.name}')
+        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
+        included.append(str(dst.relative_to(root)))
+    for src, rel in files:
+        if src.suffix.lower() in {'.exe', '.dll', '.pyd'}:
+            require_x64(src)
+        put(src, out / rel)
+    (out / (stem + '._pth')).write_text(stem + '.zip\n.\nLib/site-packages\n', encoding='utf-8')
+    included.append('bin/' + stem + '._pth')
+    # Match the existing adjacent-import gate for native package extensions.
+    # Aliases are exact bytes from the explicit runtime root, never host DLLs.
+    images = [out / rel for _, rel in files if rel.suffix.lower() in {'.exe', '.dll', '.pyd'}]
+    pending = list(images)
+    checked = set()
+    while pending:
+        image = pending.pop()
+        if image in checked:
+            continue
+        checked.add(image)
+        for name in verify.pe_imports(image):
+            if name.lower() in verify.WINDOWS_SYSTEM_DLLS or name.lower().startswith(('api-ms-win-', 'ext-ms-')):
+                continue

+                    raise RuntimeError(f'Conflicting runtime dependency: {name}')
+                continue
+            if candidate is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f'Runtime dependency is missing: {name}')
+            alias = image.parent / name
+            put(candidate, alias)
+            pending.append(alias)

+    if problems:
+        raise RuntimeError('; '.join(problems))
+    return sorted(set(included))
+

+def bundle_windows_openmp(release_root, runtime):
+    """Stage one explicitly supplied LLVM runtime under the linked MSVC name.
+
+    LLVM's OPENMP_MSVC_NAME_SCHEME uses this filename for the same runtime.
+    The producer must verify the official payload, licence and imported symbols.
+    Never discover a host Visual Studio debug_nonredist runtime implicitly.
+    """
+    root = Path(release_root)
+    verify = verifier()
+    images = [p for p in (root / 'bin').glob('*.exe') if verify.classify(p) == 'pe']
+    names = {name.lower() for p in images for name in verify.pe_imports(p)
+             if name.lower().startswith('libomp')}
+    if not names:
+        return []
+    if names != {'libomp140.x86_64.dll'}:
+        raise RuntimeError('Unsupported or mixed OpenMP runtime names')
+    if runtime is None:
+        raise RuntimeError('Linked OpenMP requires --windows-openmp-runtime')
+    source = Path(runtime)
+    dll = source / 'libomp.dll'
+    licence = source / 'LICENSE.txt'
+    if dll.is_symlink() or licence.is_symlink() or not dll.is_file() or not licence.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError('Explicit LLVM runtime and licence are required')

+    destination = root / 'bin/libomp140.x86_64.dll'
+    if any(p.name.lower().startswith('libomp') and p.name.lower() != destination.name.lower()
+           for p in (root / 'bin').iterdir()):
+        raise RuntimeError('Multiple OpenMP runtime copies are unsupported')
+    if destination.exists() and destination.read_bytes() != dll.read_bytes():
+        raise RuntimeError('Conflicting OpenMP runtime destination')

+    notice = root / 'share/licenses/llvm-openmp/LICENSE.txt'
+    notice.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy2(licence, notice)
+    problems = verify.pe_problems(root, [destination])
+    if problems:
+        raise RuntimeError('; '.join(problems))

+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
+"""Release views of a wallet-restricted RPC user must not show local funding.
+
+Wallet "pub" funds a release of this node with preparemodelfunding,
+signmodelfunding and submitmodelfunding. That records the HTLC output script
+and the funding outpoint in the release campaign of the helper. The funding
+transaction is on the chain, but these fields tie it to a wallet of this node.
+

+the release views. They must list the release without the funding txid and
+the output script. The unrestricted user still sees both.

+    "-regtestmatmulbindingheight=2147483647",

+    # name: (password, wallet restriction)

+}

+
+
+def rpcauth_line(user, password, restriction):
+    salt = os.urandom(16).hex()
+    digest = hmac.new(salt.encode(), password.encode(), "SHA256").hexdigest()
+    return f"-rpcauth={user}:{salt}${digest}:{restriction}"
+
+
+def write_safetensors(path):
+    header = json.dumps({"__metadata__": {"format": "pt"}, "w": {"dtype": "F32", "shape": [1], "data_offsets": [0, 4]}}).encode()
+    with open(path, "wb") as f:
+        f.write(struct.pack("<Q", len(header)) + header + b"\0\0\0\0")
+
+
+class RpcModelnetRestrictedCampaignFundingTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
+    def add_options(self, parser):
+        self.add_wallet_options(parser, legacy=False)
+
+    def set_test_params(self):

+        self.setup_clean_chain = True

+        conn.request("POST", "/", json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "1.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params}), headers)
+        out = json.loads(conn.getresponse().read())

+        return out["result"]
+

+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        self.wait_until(lambda: node.getmodelnetworkinfo().get("helper_ready"), timeout=60)
+        node.createwallet("wa")
+        node.createwallet("pub")
+        pub = node.get_wallet_rpc("pub")
+        mine = pub.getnewaddress()
+        self.generatetoaddress(node, 110, mine, sync_fun=self.no_op)
+
+        self.log.info("Wallet pub funds a release of this node")
+        model_dir = os.path.join(node.datadir_path, "model")
+        os.makedirs(model_dir, exist_ok=True)
+        path = os.path.join(model_dir, "toy.safetensors")
+        write_safetensors(path)
+        hosted = node.hostmodel(path)
+        height = node.getblockcount()
+        secret = hashlib.sha256(b"restricted campaign funding").digest()
+        rel = node.createmodelrelease({"uri": hosted["uri"], "secret32_hex": secret.hex(), "refund_height": height + 20,
+                                       "target_atoms": 5_000_000, "display_name": "Restricted funding"})
+        rid = rel["release_id"]
+        key_hash = rel.get("key_hash") or hashlib.sha256(secret).hexdigest()
+        claimant = pub.exportpqkey(pub.getnewaddress())["pubkey"]
+        refund_pubkey = pub.exportpqkey(pub.getnewaddress())["pubkey"]
+        amount = 2_000_000
+        frozen = pub.preparemodelfunding(rid, {"key_hash": key_hash, "claimant": claimant, "refund_pubkey": refund_pubkey,
+                                               "refund_height": height + 20, "amount_atoms": str(amount),
+                                               "fee_cap_atoms": "1000000", "auto_pay": False, "automatic_spend_atoms": "0"})
+        signed = pub.signmodelfunding(frozen["unsigned_hex"], frozen)
+        pub.submitmodelfunding(signed["hex"], frozen)
+        tx = node.decoderawtransaction(signed["hex"])
+        out = next(v for v in tx["vout"] if round(v["value"] * 100_000_000) == amount)
+        txid = tx["txid"]
+        script = out["scriptPubKey"]["hex"]
+        self.generatetoaddress(node, 2, mine, sync_fun=self.no_op)
+
+        def params(method):
+            if method in ("getmodelreleaseeconomics", "getmodelrelease"):
+                return [rid]
+            if method == "getfundablemodels":
+                return [{"limit": 20}]
+            return []
+
+        self.log.info("The unrestricted user sees the funding txid and the output script")
+        operator = json.dumps(node.getmodelrelease(rid))
+        assert txid in operator and script in operator
+
+        self.log.info("Restricted users see the release without them")
+        for user in USERS:
+            for method in READS:
+                result = json.dumps(self.call_as(user, method, params(method)))
+                assert rid in result, f"{user} {method}: release missing"
+                assert txid not in result, f"{user} {method}: funding txid visible"
+                assert script not in result, f"{user} {method}: output script visible"
+
+

+    RpcModelnetRestrictedCampaignFundingTest(__file__).main()

+"""Test that sendall refuses specified amounts whose sum is out of range.
+
+sendall checks each specified amount, then adds them up. Many amounts that are
+each in range can pass the range of CAmount. The call must be refused like any
+other request for more than the inputs hold, no transaction may be stored, and
+the wallet must keep working.
+"""
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from test_framework.blocktools import COINBASE_MATURITY, REGTEST_GENERIC_P2P_MATMUL_ARGS
+from test_framework.messages import COIN
+from test_framework.test_framework import BitcoinTestFramework
+from test_framework.util import assert_equal, assert_raises_rpc_error
+
+MAX_MONEY = 21000000 * COIN
+TOO_MUCH = "Assigned more value to outputs than available funds."
+
+
+class WalletSendallAmountSumTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
+    def add_options(self, parser):
+        self.add_wallet_options(parser, legacy=False)
+
+    def set_test_params(self):
+        self.num_nodes = 1
+        self.setup_clean_chain = True
+        self.extra_args = [["-fallbackfee=0.0002", "-modelnet=0"] + REGTEST_GENERIC_P2P_MATMUL_ARGS]
+        self.rpc_timeout = 600
+
+    def skip_test_if_missing_module(self):
+        self.skip_if_no_wallet()
+
+    def run_test(self):
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        wallet = node.get_wallet_rpc(self.default_wallet_name)
+        self.generatetoaddress(node, COINBASE_MATURITY + 10, wallet.getnewaddress(address_type="p2mr"))
+        node.createwallet("dest")
+        dest = node.get_wallet_rpc("dest")
+        remainder_addr = dest.getnewaddress(address_type="p2mr")
+        max_amount = Decimal(MAX_MONEY) / COIN
+        balance = wallet.getbalances()["mine"]["trusted"]
+        unspent = len(wallet.listunspent())
+        txs = len(wallet.listtransactions("*", 1000))
+
+        self.log.info("Specified amounts above the balance are refused (unchanged)")
+        outs = [{dest.getnewaddress(address_type="p2mr"): max_amount} for _ in range(2)]
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-6, TOO_MUCH, wallet.sendall, [remainder_addr] + outs)
+
+        self.log.info("Specified amounts whose sum passes the range of CAmount are refused")
+        count = 2**63 // MAX_MONEY + 1
+        outs = [{dest.getnewaddress(address_type="p2mr"): max_amount} for _ in range(count)]
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-6, TOO_MUCH, wallet.sendall, [remainder_addr] + outs)
+
+        self.log.info("No transaction was stored and the wallet still works")
+        assert_equal(wallet.getbalances()["mine"]["trusted"], balance)
+        assert_equal(len(wallet.listunspent()), unspent)

+        txid = wallet.sendall([remainder_addr])["txid"]
+        assert txid in node.getrawmempool()

+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
+"""Shielded wallet calls must survive an active chain that gets shorter meanwhile.
+
+The shielded wallet reads the chain height and then looks up the block at
+that height, once (the birth time of a new address) or for each height up to
+it (the rebuild and catch-up loops). If blocks are disconnected in between (a
+reorg, invalidateblock), the chain no longer reaches that height. The node
+must keep running.
+
+One thread makes new shielded addresses while another one disconnects and
+reconnects blocks below the tip.
+"""
+import threading
+
+from test_framework.authproxy import AuthServiceProxy
+from test_framework.blocktools import REGTEST_GENERIC_P2P_MATMUL_ARGS
+from test_framework.test_framework import BitcoinTestFramework
+from test_framework.util import assert_equal
+
+BLOCKS = 600
+ROUNDS = 60
+DEPTH = 25
+PASSPHRASE = "pass"
+
+
+class WalletShieldedRebuildChainShrinkTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
+    def add_options(self, parser):
+        self.add_wallet_options(parser, legacy=False)
+
+    def set_test_params(self):
+        self.num_nodes = 1
+        self.setup_clean_chain = True
+        self.extra_args = [["-autoshieldcoinbase=0", "-modelnet=0", "-rpcthreads=8"] + REGTEST_GENERIC_P2P_MATMUL_ARGS]
+        self.rpc_timeout = 600
+
+    def skip_test_if_missing_module(self):
+        self.skip_if_no_wallet()
+
+    def proxy(self, path=""):
+        return AuthServiceProxy(self.nodes[0].url + path, timeout=600)
+
+    def run_test(self):
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        node.createwallet(wallet_name="miner", descriptors=True)
+        miner = node.get_wallet_rpc("miner")
+        self.generatetoaddress(node, BLOCKS, miner.getnewaddress(), sync_fun=self.no_op)
+
+        node.createwallet(wallet_name="z", descriptors=True)
+        z = node.get_wallet_rpc("z")
+        z.encryptwallet(PASSPHRASE)
+        z.walletpassphrase(PASSPHRASE, 99999)
+        zaddr = z.z_getnewaddress()
+
+        node.createwallet(wallet_name="w", descriptors=True)
+        w = node.get_wallet_rpc("w")
+        w.encryptwallet(PASSPHRASE)
+        w.walletpassphrase(PASSPHRASE, 99999)
+        assert w.z_validateaddress(zaddr)["isvalid"]
+        w.z_getnewaddress()
+
+        self.log.info("New shielded addresses while blocks below the tip are disconnected and reconnected")
+        errors = []
+        done = threading.Event()
+
+        def rebuild_loop():
+            rpc = self.proxy("/wallet/w")
+            try:
+                while not done.is_set():
+                    rpc.z_getnewaddress()
+            except Exception as e:
+                errors.append(f"z_getnewaddress: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+
+        def reorg_loop():
+            rpc = self.proxy()
+            try:
+                for _ in range(ROUNDS):
+                    block = rpc.getblockhash(BLOCKS - DEPTH)
+                    rpc.invalidateblock(block)
+                    rpc.reconsiderblock(block)
+            except Exception as e:
+                errors.append(f"invalidateblock: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+            finally:
+                done.set()
+

+        node.restorewalletbundle(name, str(path), None, True, SHIELDED_WALLET_PASSPHRASE)
